issue.title: Mockito 5.14 + Java 21 + Maven surefire agent config : Cannot mock final class
issue.body:
Reproduction: https://github.com/lwiddershoven/mockito-issue

When maven (or IntelliJ) run my test it fails:
```
[ERROR] IssueTest.issue -- Time elapsed: 0.159 s <<< ERROR!
org.mockito.exceptions.base.MockitoException: 

Cannot mock/spy class java.lang.reflect.Method
Mockito cannot mock/spy because :
 - final class
        at IssueTest.issue(IssueTest.java:12)
```

I use:
- Mockito 5.14.2
- JVM OpenJDK Runtime Environment Temurin-21.0.5+11 (build 21.0.5+11-LTS)
- Maven: Apache Maven 3.9.9 (8e8579a9e76f7d015ee5ec7bfcdc97d26018693

I have applied the maven configuration from: https://javadoc.io/doc/org.mockito/mockito-core/latest/org/mockito/Mockito.html#mockito-instrumentation

Mockito works fine when mocking normal classes, but specifically not final classes.

The pom configuration has been picked up as the Mockito and javaagent warnings do not show up in the maven output anymore.

Relevant part of the pom:
```xml
 <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-dependency-plugin</artifactId>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>properties</goal>
                        </goals>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>${surefire-plugin.version}</version>
                <configuration>
                    <!-- Java 21+ does not allow dynamic loading/  some mockito functionality - this is how we enable that explicitly-->
                    <argLine>@{argLine} -javaagent:${org.mockito:mockito-core:jar}</argLine>
                    <systemPropertyVariables>
                        <java.util.logging.manager>org.jboss.logmanager.LogManager</java.util.logging.manager>
                        <maven.home>${maven.home}</maven.home>
                    </systemPropertyVariables>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
```

I'm not sure what more I can do to test or fix this. Any ideas?
